name: Ministerio de Educación
body: HSTS, a sitemap named in robots.txt, and GA4. But 2,725 sitemap URLs use http://mineducacion.gov.co, not the https://www.mineducacion.gov.co address the site serves, so every entry redirects.
lesson: Build the sitemap from canonical URLs: https, the www host you serve. Redirecting entries waste crawl.
summary: www.mineducacion.gov.co scores 76 out of 100 (C). 2 checks fail now, 28 are at risk, and 15 pass. Fix first: 2725 sitemap URLs point at another host or scheme.

fix.title: 2725 sitemap URLs point at another host or scheme
fix.evidence: In /sitemap.xml: mineducacion.gov.co (2725). The sitemap should list only URLs on https://www.mineducacion.gov.co.
fix.fix: Regenerate the sitemap with the production https host.

fix.title: 20 pages name another URL as canonical
fix.fix: Make each page's canonical point at itself unless it is a real duplicate.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 20 pages read.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: 2 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /portal/. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages read. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: Universal Analytics code is still on the page
fix.evidence: Google stopped processing Universal Analytics data in July 2024. The code adds weight and collects nothing.
fix.fix: Remove the UA- tag and keep GA4.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 371 ms
